facts.description: Open-source React components built with Tailwind CSS, Motion and shadcn/ui. Install any of them with one command or one prompt.

research.name: Kokonut UI
research.note: React components on Tailwind, Motion and shadcn/ui, many modeled on physical objects such as receipts, boarding passes and dials.

effects: Apple Activity Card whose three rings fill as it mounts
Page Flip card turned by dragging a page over the spine
Time Zone Planner that turns a meeting round a 24-hour dial with one ring per person
Contact Sheet picker with china-marker circling and a loupe

unverified: The component source is public in the MIT repository kokonut-labs/kokonutui (linked from the site); that repository has not yet been researched as its own candidate.
The Receipt Printer, Page Flip, Time Zone Planner and Contact Sheet effects are taken from changelog descriptions; only the Apple Activity Card was seen rendered.
